translation: By the fig and the olive

arabic: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمٖ
translation: We created man in the best design
Then reduced him to the lowest of the low

arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٖ
translation: Except those who believe and do righteous deeds; for them is a reward without end
So why do you still reject the religion
Is God not the Wisest of the wise
